audio.mp3Policy: copy FLV/SWF MP3 frames without re-encoding

audio.eventName: exact source filename stem or exact SWF SoundNNN symbol mapping
audio.loop: preserve caller loop semantics; whole-file loop starts at 0 and ends at decoded duration
audio.volume: preserve source music/sound percentage channels; no invented per-event gain

Keep unresolved event consumers and all four non-audio FLV streams inactive.
Preserve the source music/sound settings channels and whole-file loop contract.
